1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 4 m de altura, de tronco y ramas fibrosas color ceniciento, hojas menudas y baya morada oscura; su madera es muy flexible y resistente y su fruto tiene usos medicinales. Myrtaceae Eugenia monticola.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 4 m, with fibrous trunk and branches in a grayish color, small leaves, and dark purple berry; its wood is highly flexible and resistant, and its fruit has medicinal uses. Eugenia monticola (Myrtaceae).
